title: Create a Lead Generation ad with optimization location as Website
content_data:
This article introduces how to create a Lead Generation ad with optimization location as Website, driving lead-related actions on your website. Based on your preference for using a catalog to promote car inventory or models, you have the flexibility to create three types of Lead Generation ads: - Standard Lead Generation ads: This type of Lead Generation ad doesn't use a catalog to promote car inventory. For detailed instructions on creating such ads, see Create a Standard Lead Generation ad with optimization location as Website. - Automotive Ads for Inventory: This type of Lead Generation ad uses a catalog to promote car inventory. For detailed instructions on creating such ads, see [Create Automotive Ads for Inventory](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1827752507854850). - Automotive Ads for Models: This type of Lead Generation ad uses a catalog to promote car models. For detailed instructions on creating such ads, see [Create Automotive Ads for Models](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1829635758164994). # Create a Standard Lead Generation ad with optimization location as Website ## Steps ### 1. Create a campaign Create a campaign using [/campaign/create/](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1739318962329602). Note that the following requirements must be met. ```xtable | Setting {20%} | Requirement {30%} | Parameter {20%} | How to configure the parameter {30%} | |---|---|---|---| | Advertising objective | Lead Generation | `objective_type` | `LEAD_GENERATION` | | Smart+ Campaign | Disabled

To learn about how to create a Smart+ Lead Generation Campaign with optimization location as Website, see [Create Smart+ Lead Generation Campaigns](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1827645480080385#item-link-Create%20a%20Smart+%20Lead%20Generation%20Campaign%20with%20optimization%20location%20as%20Website). | / | / | |Use catalog| Disabled | `catalog_enabled` | `false` or not passed| ``` #### Example Request ```xcodeblock (code curl http) curl --location --request POST 'https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/campaign/create/' \ --header 'Access-Token: {{Access-Token}}' \ --header 'Content-Type: application/json' \ --data '{ "advertiser_id": "{{advertiser_id}}", "objective_type": "LEAD_GENERATION", "campaign_name": "{{campaign_name}}", "budget_mode": "BUDGET_MODE_TOTAL", "budget": {{budget}} }' (/code) ``` Response ```xcodeblock (code curl http) { "code": 0, "message": "OK", "request_id": "{{request_id}}", "data": { "campaign_name": "{{campaign_name}}", "modify_time": "{{modify_time}}", "objective": "LANDING_PAGE", "roas_bid": 0, "budget": {{budget}}, "secondary_status": "CAMPAIGN_STATUS_ENABLE", "is_smart_performance_campaign": false, "create_time": "{{create_time}}", "deep_bid_type": null, "campaign_type": "REGULAR_CAMPAIGN", "is_new_structure": true, "campaign_id": "{{campaign_id}}", "budget_mode": "BUDGET_MODE_TOTAL", "objective_type": "LEAD_GENERATION", "advertiser_id": "{{advertiser_id}}", "operation_status": "ENABLE" } } (/code) ``` ### 2. Create an ad group Create an ad group using [/adgroup/create/](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1739499616346114). Note that the following requirements must be met. ``` xtable | Setting {20%} | Requirement {22%} | Parameter {26%} | How to configure the parameter {32%} | |---|---|---| | Optimization location
(Promotion type) | Website | `promotion_type`
`promotion_target_type`
`pixel_id`
`optimization_event` |
  • Set `promotion_type` to `LEAD_GENERATION`,
  • Set `promotion_target_type` to `EXTERNAL_WEBSITE`,
  • If `optimization_goal` is `CONVERT`, pass in `pixel_id` and `optimization_event` at the same time.
  • If `optimization_goal` is `CLICK`, do not pass in `pixel_id` and `optimization_event` at the same time.
To obtain pixels with their associated optimization events, use [/pixel/list/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1740858697598978).| | Deep funnel optimization
(Optional) | Enabled or disabled

With deep funnel optimization, you can select a secondary event alongside the primary optimization event, which can help improve campaign effectiveness.| `deep_funnel_optimization_status`
`deep_funnel_event_source`
`deep_funnel_event_source_id`
`deep_funnel_optimization_event` |
  • To enable deep funnel optimization, set `deep_funnel_optimization_status` to `ON` and pass `deep_funnel_event_source`, `deep_funnel_event_source_id`, and `deep_funnel_optimization_event`.
  • To disable deep funnel optimization, set `deep_funnel_optimization_status` to `OFF` or leave `deep_funnel_optimization_status` unspecified. Do not pass `deep_funnel_event_source`,`deep_funnel_event_source_id`, and `deep_funnel_optimization_event`.

Note:

  • Deep funnel optimization with CRM events is currently an allowlist-only feature. If you would like to access it, please contact your TikTok representative.
  • Deep funnel optimization with Pixel or Offline events is generally available.
| | Placement |Any of the following options:
  • Automatic Placement
  • Select Placement with TikTok placement, or Pangle placement, or TikTok and Pangle placement
| `placement_type`
`placements` | Any of the following configurations:
  • Set `placement_type` to `PLACEMENT_TYPE_AUTOMATIC`
  • Set `placement_type` to `PLACEMENT_TYPE_NORMAL`, and set `placements` to ` ["PLACEMENT_TIKTOK"]`, or `["PLACEMENT_PANGLE"]`, or ` ["PLACEMENT_TIKTOK","PLACEMENT_PANGLE"]`.
| | Optimization goal | Any of the following options:
  • Conversions
  • Click
| `optimization_goal` | Any value below:
  • `CONVERT`
  • `CLICK`
| | Billing event |
  • If optimization goal is set to Conversions, set billing event to oCPM.
  • If optimization goal is set to Click, set billing event to CPC.
| `billing_event` |
  • If `optimization_goal` is set to `CLICK`, specify `billing_event` as `CPC`.
  • If `optimization_goal` is set to `CONVERT`, specify `billing_event` as `OCPM`.
| | Bid strategy & Delivery Type |
  • If Bid Strategy is set to Cost Cap, you can set Delivery Type to Standard or Accelerated.
  • If Bid Strategy is set to Maximum Delivery, you can only set Delivery Type to Standard.
| `bid_type`
`pacing` |
  • If you specify `bid_type` as `BID_TYPE_CUSTOM`, you can set `pacing` to `PACING_MODE_SMOOTH` or `PACING_MODE_FAST`.
  • If you specify `bid_type` as `BID_TYPE_NO_BID`, you can only set `pacing` to `PACING_MODE_SMOOTH`.

3. Create an ad Create an ad using [/ad/create/](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1739953377508354). Note that the following requirements must be met. ```xtable | Setting {20%} | Requirement {30%} | Parameter {20%} | How to configure the parameter {30%} | |---|---|---|---| | Ad format | Any of the following options:
  • Single video
  • Single image
  • Carousel images

Note:

  • To set ad format to single image, you need to specify the placement as Select Placement with Pangle only at the ad group level.
  • To set ad format to Carousel images, you need to specify the placement as Automatic Placement or Select Placement with TikTok placement included at the ad group level.
| `ad_format` | Any of the following values:
  • `SINGLE_VIDEO`
  • `SINGLE_IMAGE`
  • `CAROUSEL_ADS`

Note:

  • To set `ad_format` to `SINGLE_IMAGE`, specify `placement_type` as `PLACEMENT_TYPE_NORMAL` and `placements` as `["PLACEMENT_PANGLE"]` at the ad group level first.
    • To learn about how to create single image ads, see [Create single image ads](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1777633230937090).
  • To set `ad_format` to `CAROUSEL_ADS`, either specify `placement_type` as `PLACEMENT_TYPE_AUTOMATIC` or specify `placement_type` as `PLACEMENT_TYPE_NORMAL` and include `PLACEMENT_TIKTOK` in the value of `placements` at the ad group level first.
    • To learn about how to create Standard Carousel Ads, see [Steps for creating Standard Carousel Ads](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1766217791987713#item-link-Steps%20for%20creating%20Standard%20Carousel%20Ads).
| | Interactive add-on
(Optional for single video ads) |
  • When ad format is single video and the placement includes TikTok, the only supported types are Display Card, Gift Code Sticker, and Countdown Sticker.
  • When ad format is single image or Carousel images, interactive add-ons are not supported.
| `card_id` |
  • When `ad_format` is `SINGLE_VIDEO` and at the ad group level `placement_type` is `PLACEMENT_TYPE_AUTOMATIC` or `placement_type` is `PLACEMENT_TYPE_NORMAL` and `PLACEMENT_TIKTOK` is included in the value of `placements`, you can specify the Display Card ID or ID of a Countdown Sticker or Gift Code Sticker portfolio.
    • To learn about how to get the Display Card ID, see [Cards](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1749019652141058).
    • To find out how to create a Countdown Sticker or Gift Code Sticker portfolio, see [Stickers](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1749019667506177).
  • When `ad_format` is `SINGLE_IMAGE` or `CAROUSEL_ADS`, `card_id` is not supported.
| | Destination | Any of the following options:
  • URL
  • Custom Page
| `landing_page_url`
`page_id` |
  • To specify Destination as URL, specify the landing page URL of the website that has the Website Form via `landing_page_url`.
  • To specify Destination as Custom Page, specify the TikTok Instant Page that redirects to the website that has the Website Form via `page_id`.
    • To create a TikTok Instant Page, you can use [Instant Page Editor SDK](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1740307202170881) and set `businessType` to `6`.
    • After you create a TikTok Instant Page, call [/page/get/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1820826387779586) to get the page ID.
| ``` #### Example Request ```xcodeblock (code curl http) curl --location --request POST 'https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/ad/create/' \ --header 'Access-Token: {{Access-Token}}' \
